prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished, practical game-VFX design board based on the supplied real gameplay screenshots. This is a design preview, NOT claimed to be a real screenshot.
Inputs: Image 1 is the exact Karen combat scene, red lower-left energy counter, tower, character and UI layout reference. Image 2 shows the existing energy feedback and density reference. Preserve their hand-painted anime/card-game visual language.
Primary request: Redesign the persistent occupied/empty state of the ability "舞台正在等待着" so ALL persistent state graphics attach to the EXISTING LOWER-LEFT RED ENERGY COUNTER. Completely eliminate the small cyan chest oval, chest slit, chest halo and belly light ball. Do not relocate those same shapes onto the counter. Create a new subtle theatrical edge-light treatment integrated into the counter's existing irregular hexagonal silhouette.
Layout: landscape design sheet, three equal columns at the top, each showing an enlarged crop of the energy counter and adjacent unchanged cave/game UI area. At the bottom, one wide actual-scale combat context strip, showing that the proposed small energy-counter decoration stays away from Karen and the promise tower. Keep scene/counter proportions consistent. The three upper crops must use the exact same zoom and counter placement. Put labels in a clean dark caption area outside the game scene.
Exact Chinese column headings:
"有牌 · 候场"
"清空 · 实际回能"
"空堆 · 待续"
Small footer "设计预览 · 非实机"
Design:
1. OCCUPIED / WAITING: keep the original red faceted energy counter and its cream "8/3" digits intact. A very fine subdued warm-gold grazing-light trim hugs ONLY the existing lower-left and lower outside edges. Warm light gathered tightly at the perimeter, calm and compact. One continuous edge light, NOT dots indicating card/energy amounts. No rotating ring.
2. REAL EMPTY TRANSITION / ACTUAL ENERGY GAIN: retain counter shape, cream digits now "9/3". Two delicate short white-gold particle streaks approach from just above-right and converge at the counter rim, producing a brief localized edge flash and a few tiny sparks. Digits stay clean and legible; no explosion covers them. This is the sole bright peak. No long beam crosses the battlefield. No chest-origin particle line.
3. ALREADY EMPTY / QUIET WAIT: same red counter and "9/3" digits, no numerical change or floating +1. Very soft low-intensity cool pearl-blue grazing light along a few of the existing upper-right outline edges, with two or three tiny drifting dust flecks nearby. Resting, quiet, no pulsing recharge meter or filled energy gauge. Visually distinguish from the warm gathered occupied trim, but do not make it look like more energy is being gained.
Context strip: keep Karen and the tower clearly visible and unchanged with their normal painted silhouettes; show occupied energy-counter trim at native small screen scale, and NO permanent aura or chest ornament on Karen. Existing battlefield and hand UI are retained.
Hard constraints: all new persistent graphics within about 15 pixels outside the energy counter at original 1280x720 scale, transient streaks within about 55 pixels. The orb must remain the original red native game counter, not a redesigned sci-fi meter. No new energy digits, fake resource, progress segments, duplicate power icon, large star, base/pedestal, ring, chest mark, doorway, curtain panels, large wings, ribbons or tower changes. No photorealistic props. No added recurring giant spotlights. Use restrained particle effects and edge lighting, not decorative hardware.
